title: CakePHP 4.5.12, 4.6.5, 5.1.8 through 5.1.10, 5.2.14 through 5.2.15, 5.3.7, and 5.4.0 through 5.4.3 contain an email…
description: Certain versions of CakePHP contain an email header injection vulnerability due to incomplete sanitization of header values in SmtpTransport and MailTransport. Attackers who can control custom email headers via Message::setHeaders() or Message::addHeaders() may inject bare carriage return (CR) or line feed (LF) characters, enabling injection of additional headers such as Bcc. This could allow redirection or alteration of outgoing emails.
